name: orbit-dollhouse-desktop-swiftshader
description: REVIEW area 2 orbit/dollhouse matrix, REDUCED SwiftShader arm. Desktop 1200x900, capable pinned, hours 13 + 21, lights off+on, 6 poses (boot, a45e35, a225e35, a45e60, top-down, kitchen dolly), realistic tier, orbit mode.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: assert-orbit
steps.eval: (() => { const m = window.__store.getState().cameraMode; if (m !== 'orbit') throw new Error('expected orbit, got ' + m) })()

steps.name: hide-hud
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('orbit-mode') })()

steps.name: install-helpers
probe-boot
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const gl = window.__three.gl; const c = gl.getContext(); const d = c.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info'); const b = window.__boot; console.log('[probe] arm orbit-dollhouse-desktop-swiftshader tier=' + s.qualityTier + ' device=' + s.deviceClass + ' dpr=' + gl.getPixelRatio() + ' mode=' + s.cameraMode + ' bootPos=' + b.p.map(n=>n.toFixed(2)).join(',') + ' bootTgt=' + b.g.map(n=>n.toFixed(2)).join(',') + ' renderer=' + (d ? c.getParameter(d.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL) : 'n/a')) })()
